author: opus-claude
text:
v0.5 UI: v0.3-shape fs_watcher prefixes + git_tree renderer

Replace v0.1/v0.2 watch prefixes and shape detection with v0.3-only
support per ARCH §2.2 / §3.5.

fs_watcher now matches conv-repo control files (manifest.yaml,
workflow.yaml, providers.yaml, version, souls/), per-worktree contents
under any first-segment subdir (goal.md, soul.md, summary/, steps/,
descriptions/, skills/, .gitattributes), and the primary worktree's
refs (root/.git/HEAD, root/.git/refs/).

git_tree resolves the passed conv-repo path to <conv-repo>/root/
before any git command. Conversation detection keys off
steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/... paths introduced by --no-ff merges; preview
pulled from steps/<conv-id>/001/request.json. In-flight enumeration
drops the ex/ prefix filter and surfaces every unmerged ref under
refs/heads/. Renames ExchangeBranch -> ConversationBranch and
exchange_id -> conv_id, aligning with TAXONOMY.

Tests rewritten against a v0.3-shape conv-repo fixture. Workspace
coverage 100% via cargo tarpaulin --fail-under 100.
